name: Parker Solar Probe
tagline: Closest spacecraft to the Sun ever flown
description: NASA's Sun-grazing mission. Launched 2018-08-12 on a Delta IV Heavy + Star 48BV stack at the highest C3 ever achieved for a science payload (154 km²/s²). Seven Venus gravity assists over six years walked perihelion in from 0.16 AU (P1) to 0.046 AU (P22, 2024-12-24) — 9.86 solar radii, 6.1 million km from the Sun's surface. At P8 (2021-04-28) Parker dipped below the Alfvén critical surface — the first spacecraft to enter the Sun's corona. Peak speed at perihelion: 192 km/s, the fastest human-made object ever.
best_known_for: Closest spacecraft to the Sun ever flown (9.86 R☉)
